'''Sloth bear men''' are [[animal people]] versions of the [[sloth bear]], who can be found in [[savage]] [[tropical]] [[forest]]s. They spawn in groups of 1-5 individuals and are generally content to keep to themselves, but may fight back if provoked. In terms of size, they are a little larger than the average [[human]].

Like other savage animal people, they can join [[civilization]]s, become [[historical figure]]s, appear as [[visitor]]s and be playable in [[adventurer mode]].

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] sloth bear men for their ''large floppy ears''.
